text.title: Slots must be short to be convenient, but couriers need long windows
text.need_a: a slot the buyer can book within 1 hour (benefit X: convenience)
text.need_not_a: a window of 3+ hours for couriers (benefit Y: efficient routes)
text.ikr: slots are short for buyers and long for couriers, at no extra cost
text.resources: order history by hour, courier GPS data, 6 dark stores
text.principle: separation in time: short slots at peak hours, long windows at night
text.solution: Separate short slots for regulars, long windows for new users (segmentation in time)
text.check: Late deliveries 4% → 2.5% after 3 weeks in two districts; rollout from 1 October
